item.p: Grammar (grammars/xquery, ): XQUF 3.0, Appendix A: the revalidation declaration, "declare updating" (the compatibility annotation, accepted before the other annotations), insert, delete, replace (value of), rename, copy-modify, transform-with (at the arrow level, under XQuery 4.0's pipeline) and "invoke updating". The 17 new keywords stay names. Every query and module of the upd-* sets parses; the rest of XQ40 parses as before.
AST: ten kinds, the fields modify and source, the keywords FIRST, LAST, INTO, AFTER, BEFORE, SKIP, the flag VALUE_OF.

Static rules (XQUF 3.0, 2.2, 5.1 to 5.4) in src/xquery_update.c: one post-order walk over a module's AST by its links (no stack, ) gives each expression a category, simple, updating or vacuous, and checks XUST0001, XUST0002 and XUST0028. %updating and %simple are accepted on functions and function items, XUST0032 on variables and XUST0033 twice: this replaces 's place, the XQST0045 of check_annotations in src/xquery_static.c.

A pending update list is a sequence. Each update primitive is a function item named upd:insertInto ... upd:rename whose body raises XUDY0038 when called; its captured values are the target, the parameter and the kind. So no item kind is added (xdm.h is frozen, ), the evaluator keeps no update state, and merging the lists of the comma, FLWOR, conditional and function call expressions is concatenation (upd:mergeUpdates is a union); a try clause that fails loses its updates with its value. The static rules keep primitives where no XDM value is read.

Lowering (the part , src/xquery_lower_update.c): every update expression is a STATIC_CALL of an internal native row in no function table, as group by is (), which checks the operands (XUTY0004 to XUTY0013, XUDY0009, XUDY0023, XUDY0027, XUDY0029, XUDY0030, XUTY0022) and returns the primitives. replace value of takes its value through a TEXT_CONSTRUCTOR (5.4.3.2: "as in a text node constructor"). copy-modify is copy(E) per variable, the modify clause, then modify-copies, which applies the clause's list to the copies (XUDY0014) and rebinds the variables for the return clause.

Application (src/xquery_update_apply.c, upd:applyUpdates): the compatibility checks (XUDY0015, XUDY0016, XUDY0017, XUDY0024), then each target tree is rebuilt through the tree builder in one pass over the old tree with every primitive of a node applied in the order of 3.2.2; tree.h does not change (). Changed elements and their ancestors become untyped; a duplicate attribute is XUDY0021.

The host (include/sxml/xquery.h, additive): an updating query is a unit whose main function carries %updating; sxml_xquery_query_is_updating says so, and the evaluation request's update sink receives each changed tree (its old and new roots) after the snapshot. How a change is made persistent is the host's (upd:applyUpdates: implementation-defined).
QT4 driver: XQUpdate is supported; the tests of a test case run in order, each updating one's changed trees replace the sources they came from, and the last test's result is checked.

Done in 7.7a (amended at the end of the packet): besides the above, transform-with (a MAP whose body copies the item and lowers the modify clause with the copy as fixed focus), the prolog's construction and copy-namespaces modes for copies and for the nodes insert and replace copy in, upd:removeType (only the primitives that change a type touch their node and its ancestors, which become xs:anyType when typed), upd:propagateNamespace under no-inherit, XUDY0021 also inside removed subtrees, and sxml xquery writing the context document as an updating query left it (no flag; the file is not changed).

upd-* (XQ40, release driver): before 0 of 825 run; after 733 passed (10 of them with another error code), 24 failed, 0 errors, 68 not run: 27 staticTyping, 40 revalidation lax and strict (XUST0026 until 7.7c), 1 that needs skip unsupported.

Left for 7.7b (the 4.0 draft): the updating return clause of copy-modify (id-transform-expr-014), XUDY0038 on a dynamic call of an updating function item (no test), the 4.0 draft's other additions. For 7.7c: fn:put (13 cases) and revalidation lax and strict (40, with revalidate-valtrans-ins-003). Not ours: copies made with construction strip keep is-id and is-idrefs (sxml_tree_builder_copy_node, src/tree.c: "the ID properties stay"), so 11 cases that ask for schema IDs to go fail (setToUntyped, transform-expr-045 to -048); 6 propagateNamespace cases differ only in whitespace that assert-xml compares; valskip-repnode-006 revalidates a source with an IDREF.
